notes.title: SURVIVORS LEFT: X is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33814580/c267651be47976e38c687ee11affafda0f76f86e.gif[/img]
Here we go. 
My first game dev experience finally can see the light! It was hard but fun time and now it all yours.
Endlessly running survivors and danger of another's word. Only your keyboard and fingers can keep survivors alive. 
We feel pretty relived and satisfied. First step in this journey. Who knows where this step will lead us? Hope not in some dark place (: 
Anyway thank you all who will read it (it good to be heard).
Game is ready and working - we ready for make it better aswel. 

Work is not finished yet for sure. We will fix what needed to be fixed and may be do few localisations.

Have a good time (:
